notes: NAME AND DEATH DATE FLAGGED (research 2026-07-03): the compiled PEI family history (theblacketts.com/node/34) names this Rotherhithe-born (1750) shipwright, who emigrated to PEI, simply 'William Blackett,' son of John Blackett and Mary — not 'John William Blackett.' Separately, this record's death date, '28 Dec 1867, Prince Edward Island,' is a duplicate-record artifact: that exact date is the sourced death date of his daughter, Catherine 'Kate' Blackett Swallow (I182195863389), per islandregister.com/swallow.html. A man baptised 1750 dying in 1867 would be 117 years old; his true death date is not established by any source found and should be treated as unknown rather than 1867.
